children: Stacks opens Bond 4, its fourth Bitcoin staking bond, on 27 Nov 2026. The opening gives users room to make new staking deposits, with a total of 1,050 BTC available across all deposits into the bond.
STX is the asset that supports the bond's staking capacity. As users deposit BTC into the bond and fill that capacity, demand for STX could rise.

title: Stacks: Bond 4 opens for Bitcoin staking - 27 Nov 2026
